title: 131 Padma Awards 2026 Announced
summary: 2026 Republic Day honours list features 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan, and 113 Padma Shri awardees.

blocks.content: Government announced **131 Padma Awards for 2026** (5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan, 113 Padma Shri), including 19 women, 6 Foreigners/NRIs/PIOs, and 16 posthumous awardees.

items: **Key Awardees**: Rohit Sharma, Harmanpreet Kaur (cricket), Savita Punia (hockey), I.M. Vijayan (football), R. Madhavan (art).
**Hierarchy**: Bharat Ratna → Padma Vibhushan (2nd) → Padma Bhushan (3rd) → Padma Shri (4th).
